free_resources.title: Guided Meditation for Womb Healing
free_resources.description: A gentle free meditation for slowing down and listening to the energy of the womb space, whether or not a physical uterus is there. Julie frames the body as something that holds messages if we pay attention.

free_resources.title: Gentle Self-Affirming Sleep Meditation for Anxiety and Stress
free_resources.description: A free bedtime meditation of kind reminders that you are doing okay and that mistakes are allowed, moving from love for others towards love for yourself as you drift off.

left_out: WANT: 8 Steps to Recovering Desire, Passion, and Pleasure After Sexual Assault: passes the new health rule (a memoir and guide to recovery after trauma), but her book page (juliepeters.ca/wantbook) gives no ISBN, ASIN or publisher link, and no publisher page was found; not restored.
Intuitive Somatic Counselling sessions: counselling/therapy, a scope rule rather than the health rule; still out.

Her other condition-named tracks ('Mindfulness Meditation for Chronic Pain', 'Healing Meditation for Injury, Surgery or Illness', 'Gut Medicine' SIBO/IBS tracks, 'Energy Magic Spell for Pain, Sickness or Sadness'): not added; the listing is held to 5 free resources, and the illness and gut tracks would need a closer look for treatment claims.
